get.description:
Get the transactions for a specified account. 
- Filtering is done using the `postingDate` (the date the transaction affects your balance). 
- If you want to include pending transactions, use the `includePending=true` query parameter. 
- The `transactionType` query parameter can be used to filter transactions by type.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Refers to the date range filter's start date. Will default to today's date, minus 180 days, if not specified.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Refers to the date range filter's end date. Will default to today's date if not specified.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description:
Refers to the transaction type filter's value. 
- VASTransactions = Airtime and bundles.
- AllCardTransactions = All card transactions. 
- FasterPay = Faster payments. 
- All = Transactional history with balance. 
- ATMWithdrawals = ATM withdrawals. 
- BudgetInstalments = Budget instalments. 
- CardPurchases = Card purchases.
- Debit Orders = Debit orders.
- Deposits = Deposits.
- FeesAndInterest = Fees and interest 
- JourneyCardPurchases = Journey card purchase.
- OnlineBankingPayments = Online banking payments. 
- OverTheCounterTransactions = Over the counter.
- SendCash = Send cash transactions. 
- PayShap = PayShap payments. 
- MCPBAPocketTransfer = Pocket transfer.

post.description:
Make a payment to one or more beneficiaries. 
- Beneficiaries need to be created online, and a payment made online, before payments can be made via the API.
- If you want to make multiple payments from one account, list these in the paymentList in the Body of the request.
- Size limit of 50 payments per request.
- If payment(s) need to be authorised, make sure to add the following fields in the body of the request. You can get these from the Get AuthorisationSetUpDetails endpoint: authoriserAId, authoriserBId, authPeriodId and fasterPayment. 
- Payments that don't include an authorisation step, don't need these fields.

authoriserAId.description: If the payment requires authorisation this is derived from profiles/{profileId}/accounts/{accountId}/authorisationsetupdetails.

authoriserBId.description: If the payment requires authorisation this is derived from profiles/{profileId}/accounts/{accountId}/authorisationsetupdetails.

authPeriodId.description: If the payment requires authorisation this is derived from profiles/{profileId}/accounts/{accountId}/authorisationsetupdetails.

fasterPayment.description: If the payment requires authorisation this can be set to true if the beneficiary allows it from profiles/{profileId}/beneficiaries/{accountId}.

TransferResponses.Status:
- No authorisation necessary
- Payment/Transfer effective date 06/04/2022

get.description:
Get a list of all beneficiaries available to you. 
- Beneficiaries must be created via Investec Online before they appear in the list. 
- For additional security, you will only be able to pay a beneficiary via the API after a payment has been made on Investec Online. 
- If you would like payment notification to go out to a beneficiary, ensure that the beneficiary email address and cell phone number is filled in on Investec Online. 
- If these are null, no notification will be sent out to that notification channel.

postingDate.description:
Date when a transaction entry is posted to an account on the account servicer's books.
Usage: Booking date is the expected booking date, unless the status is booked, in which case it is the actual booking date.

valueDate.description:
Date at which assets become available to the account owner in case of a credit entry, or ceases to be available to the account owner in case of a debit transaction entry.
 Usage: If transaction entry status is pending and value date is present, then the value date refers to an expected/requested value date.
For transaction entries subject to availability/float and for which availability information is provided, the value date must not be used. In this case the availability component identifies the number of availability days

post.description:
Get full card details, including card number, expiry date and CVV.

 **A note on usage:** 
- To retrieve sensitive card data, you must first generate an RSA key pair on an app of your choice. 
- Next, provide your RSA public key in the request, along with: 
  - `modulus` and `exponent` (public key components)
  - `appName` (the application used to generate the key pair). 

 Once you have sent the request, the API will: 
- Encrypt the card number, expiry date, and CVV using your public key 
- Return the encrypted values in `ExtendedDetails`. 
 You can then decrypt these values locally using your private key. 

| Area                   | Value     |
| :------                | :-------  |
| Encryption Algorithm   | RSA       |
| Key Size               | 2048      |
